<thought>Carbon shows the characteristic 1 Da spacing of 13C isotopes, and the strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the monoisotopic intensity matches the ~3:1 ratio typical for a single chlorine atom (Cl‑35/Cl‑37). No other element shows a definitive isotopic signature in this spectrum. Therefore the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
